pr_title: ADR 0123: close Behavior Tree visual validation
pr_body:
## Summary

- keep the schema-driven palette fixture and Play-mode debugger evidence in one deterministic Windows Editor capture
- place the validation-only palette, live debug graph, and runtime details side-by-side in a foreground validation workspace so normal Hierarchy/Assets docks cannot clip required evidence
- leave normal Editor layout, Behavior Tree runtime semantics, persisted documents, stable IDs, and public APIs unchanged

## Validation

Re-run affected Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation, then review the actual artifact for all ADR 0123 first-release palette/debugger evidence and layout quality.
